name: Naira Reach
description: Pays a Nigerian freelancer for a client abroad, in naira on Celo. It checks the invoice, converts the client's USD₮ to cNGN through Textile FX, and pays the exact naira billed to a private address only the freelancer can open. It works from the client's own Altana wallet, under a session key with weekly caps, a list of allowed calls and an expiry.
